hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && git fetch -q 2>/dev/null && n=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{u} 2>/dev/null) && [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ] && { git pull -q --ff-only 2>/dev/null && echo "Pulled $n new commit(s) from origin before this session." || echo "origin is $n commit(s) ahead and could not fast-forward (local changes or diverged) - resolve before working."; }; exit 0
